metadata.prompt:
30-second photorealistic romantic drama. Two shots connected by a match cut on a gesture. Same golden-hour window light in both shots. Same room. Same woman. 35mm anamorphic 2.39:1, shallow depth of field, heavy organic film grain, 24fps, warm amber and gold palette with soft halation and anamorphic lens flare. Natural, imperfect human beings. No plastic skin. No AI gloss. Intimate camera — slow imperceptible push-in with the gentlest living handheld drift, like breathing.

[Reference image 1: the couple laughing face-to-face in golden light, man at right of frame]
[Reference image 2: the woman alone, head tilted back, tear on right cheek, bittersweet smile, looking up and to the right]

CHARACTERS:
THE WOMAN: late 20s, freckles across nose and cheeks, dark brown wavy hair with loose strands catching light, light eyes, natural skin with visible pores and fine lines. Muted earth-tone knit sweater.
THE MAN: late 30s, dark hair with gray at temples, short beard, weathered kind face with deep crinkles at the eyes, light-colored shirt.

LIGHTING: Warm golden-hour sunlight from behind-left, backlighting hair with glowing rim, anamorphic lens flares, halation. Same light direction and quality in both shots. Thick late-afternoon sun through a window, floating dust motes. Warm shadows. Indoor setting — blurred warm walls and soft window glow in backgrounds.

CAMERA: Slow push-in throughout. Gentlest handheld drift — not shaky, just alive. No zooms. No whip pans.

[0:00-0:13] SHOT 1 — MEDIUM CLOSE-UP, the couple. Based on reference image 1.
They hold each other face to face, arms wrapped tight. The woman tilts her head back laughing up at the man on her right — mouth open, teeth showing, eyes crinkled shut, nose scrunched, freckles across her nose. The man's face is close to her temple, short beard near her hairline, laughing too, looking down at her with eyes nearly closed from smiling. Her hair spills between them, backlit gold from behind-left.
At 0:04 she laughs so hard she tries to pull back, one hand pushing playfully at his chest. He tightens his arms, not letting go, turning his mouth to her ear.
0:05 — THE MAN (low, half-playful, half-serious, murmured into her ear): "Don't go."
0:07 — THE WOMAN (still laughing, eyes crinkled, not taking it seriously): "I'm not going anywhere."
0:09 — THE MAN (quiet smile against her hair, barely audible, certain): "Good."
He presses a kiss into her hairline. Her laughter softens to a smile. She turns her face toward his shoulder, eyes closing for a beat. At 0:12 she begins to lift her chin, pulling back just enough to look up at him where he stands at her right —
CUT ON THE MOTION OF HER LIFTING FACE, her gaze already angled up and to the right toward him.

[0:13-0:30] SHOT 2 — CLOSE-UP to EXTREME CLOSE-UP, the woman alone. Based on reference image 2.
Match cut: her face finishes the lifting motion. Tight close-up — head tilted back, same angle as shot 1, same warm backlight from behind-left rim-lighting her hair and right cheekbone. She is alone in frame. The background is the same indoor warm blur — soft walls, window glow, dust motes — but the man is gone. The shoulder of her earth-tone knit sweater is visible at the lower edge of frame.
Her smile hasn't faded yet. Her gaze remains up and to the right, exactly where he was standing. For a beat she is still looking at him. Then her eyes search — finding only light. The smile softens, becomes private, bittersweet.
Micro-expression sequence — involuntary, anatomically real:
0:15 — A slower blink than normal, lids closed a fraction too long. When they open, the eyes are brighter — tear film pooling along the lower lash line, not yet falling. Gaze stays on the empty space at right.
0:18 — Mouth corners lift a little more, as if remembering the joke. Chin dimples holding the smile. One deeper breath lifts her chest; nostrils flare softly.
0:21 — One tear breaks free from the inner corner of her right eye and tracks slowly down her right cheek, catching golden light, leaving a wet shiny trail across freckles. She does not wipe it. She does not look away from where he was.
0:24 — Her gaze shifts very slightly, softening — not to camera, just drifting in the warm light. The smile reaches her eyes now: not happy, not sad, something larger — gratitude, acceptance, a goodbye that is also a thank-you. Lower lip trembles once, presses together, releases.
0:27 — The smallest nod. Barely perceptible. A strand of hair moves with her breath. The tear hangs on her cheekbone refracting amber.
0:29 — Expression settles into perfect quiet. The smile remains. The light blooms.
SLOW FADE TO WHITE.

AUDIO:
0:00-0:10: Simple piano melody — bright, unhurried, major key, like a perfect afternoon remembered. Under it: soft fabric of their embrace, distant birdsong through glass, room hush in late sun. Her laughter close-mic'd and genuine — unguarded, shoulders shaking. The three lines of dialogue are close-mic'd, intimate, almost whispered — faces inches apart.
0:10-0:13: Piano sustains one note. Single cello joins, long and warm. Laughter fades to soft exhale. The kiss almost silent.
0:13-0:20: Cello carries melody now, piano falling back to sparse single notes. Room tone same but emptier. Her breathing — slightly deeper, slightly unsteady. No sob. No gasp. Just breath. No dialogue.
0:20-0:30: Cello fades. Only piano remains, one note at a time, spaced like heartbeats. Not sad — tender, like hands letting go. Faint wind outside. On fade to white, piano holds one chord resolving into silence.

NEGATIVE: No sobbing. No open-mouthed crying. No hand-to-face drama. No running. No other people. No additional dialogue in shot 2. No mouthed words. No mascara running. No red puffy eyes — quiet tears, not grief. No morphing. No deformation. No identity shift between shots. No plastic skin. No airbrushed pores. No symmetry. No glowing eyes. No ghostly superimpositions. No unnatural slow-motion. No man visible in shot 2. No outdoor backgrounds in shot 2. No change of wardrobe.

TECHNICAL: Photorealistic. Natural skin with freckles, pores, subtle oil, fine lines. Eyes naturally moist — not glistening or over-wet. Single clear tear track on right cheek, not a flood. Hair moves with breath and micro head movements. Same woman in both shots — exact face, freckles, hair, skin tone, sweater preserved. Same man in shot 1. Same golden light from behind-left in both shots. Same indoor warm background blur. 35mm anamorphic: oval bokeh, horizontal flares, edge softness, halation. Organic grain. 4K. 24fps. Realistic physics. No flickering. No ghosting. Dialogue clear and natural, not ADR-stiff.

Natural skin texture with visible pores, freckles, fine lines under eyes. 35mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, heavy organic film grain, warm amber and gold color grade, same camera angle and lighting direction as the reference image, photoreal cinematic still, intimate, bittersweet.
